host_context.note: Idle RAM snapshot is not peak-load approval and does not authorize activation.

existing_overlay_memory_limits_gib.note: App-facing deploy limits remain outside the media slice.

recommended_budget.notes: No shared overcommit: aggregate MemoryMax equals sum of the three per-container hard limits (768+1152+256=2176M). MEDIA_EXECUTOR_MAX_JOBS=concurrency is enforced per executor process by release settings + runtime reservation; offline and network executors can still run simultaneously, so the aggregate must cover both plus egress-proxy. Worker retains its own 1024M deploy limit outside this slice. OWNER APPROVAL PENDING / NOT INSTALLED.

disk_budget.notes: Single dedicated host filesystem for tmp+executor+media-net. Capacity equals calculated peak+reserve; not free-disk, max_bytes, or post-reap reject.

concurrency_enforcement.executor_max_jobs: MEDIA_EXECUTOR_MAX_JOBS set from budget.concurrency on media-executor and media-net-executor; asserted by assert_running_media_budget; enforced in ExecutorServer reservation
concurrency_enforcement.implication: Memory and disk peaks assume both executors may be busy at once.

egress_proxy_slice_membership.generated_settings_cgroup_parent: plan.slice_unit for all three budgeted services
egress_proxy_slice_membership.post_start_proof: assert_running_media_budget requires HostConfig.CgroupParent == slice_unit for egress-proxy

rationale: Removes the prior shared_ceiling overcommit that assumed concurrency=1 prevents simultaneous offline+network peaks.
Aligns slice template, compose overlay mem_limit defaults, generated media-settings, and this proposal on one numeric contract.
CPUQuota 100% and TasksMax 512 leave headroom for API/worker/postgres while allowing both executors under the slice.
Disk capacity is derived from MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES=3GiB with handoff amplification and retained publish copies; product limits/retention are not reduced.
